svg.text: Moon Stone Plant · 12 Export Lines → 12 Sell Boxes · 24 Capsule Catchers · 48 Pressure Chambers · 108 Stone Presses
≈ 1,041.6 blocks/min · ≈ 62,496 blocks per daylight hour · 2,424 kW while running · 152 solar trackers · 228 splitters · 24 merges

Figures read from the game (MoonWorld specs) and a capsule-by-capsule simulation of one line (2-lane splitters alternate and skip a full lane). Lines share no belt, splitter or machine, so the plant is 12 × one line. Rates in kg (= capsules) per minute; ½ ¼ ⅛ = share a splitter offers each lane.
Assumed (not yet checked in game): 1 kg dust → 1 kg sand; a full catcher's outfeed fills its belt (88/min); stone blocks sit on a lane like capsules (0.75 m apart).

≈ 62,496 blocks per hour · ≈ 22.1 million per lunar daylight (354 h)
Pressure chambers: 48 · sand 1,056 kg/min (each 22 of 25, 88% busy)
Splitters: 228 (A1–A3, S1–S8, D1–D8 per line) · merges: 24
Belts per line: 2 dust + 1 sand (all full, 88/min) + 1 stone lane
Smaller build: 12 × (4 chambers + 8 presses) ≈ 958.4 blocks/min, 2,208 kW,
138 trackers, every press at full speed from the start (8% less stone, ~same per tracker)
Sharing belts between lines could at best save 5 chambers + 2 presses (86 kW, 3.5%):
floor of 43 chambers and 106 presses, at the cost of belts crossing lines.
152 × 16 kW peak = 2,432 kW for a 2,424 kW load (12 lines × 202 kW) · trackers follow the sun
Batteries: 152 × 10 kWh × 0.92 charge efficiency = 1,398 kWh ≈ 35 min of full load
Moon clock runs in real time: lunar day ≈ 29.53 days, ≈ 354 h of daylight; production stops in the lunar night.
2-lane splitter: alternates capsules, skips a full lane
stone press (shaded: P8/P9 positions, fill last)
½ · 44 = share a splitter offers that lane · kg/min offered
Every line is identical; build one, check it, then copy it 11 times.
Sand tree (S1–S8, above the presses) and dust tree (D1–D8, below) have the same
shape, so every press gets one sand and one dust input.
P1–P7 positions are offered 11/min and take 10; the overflow skips on to the
P8/P9 positions (1/16 each + overflow), which fill last: ~1–2 h to full speed.
Machine stores (12 dust, 12 sand, 10 blocks per press) stay full overnight.
